title: Atlanta Fiber System Experiment: Overview
version: The Bell System Technical Journal 57(6), part 1, July–August 1978, pp. 1717–1721. DOI 10.1002/j.1538-7305.1978.tb02121.x.
lineage: Original Bell System engineering publication, accessed as a World Radio History facsimile of the printed issue. The local reading notes identify the inspected scan by SHA-256.

passages.locator: Printed p. 1717 / PDF p. 1, opening and experiment objectives
passages.note: The project sent 44.7 Mb/s over the entire system on 13 January 1976 at the joint Western Electric and Bell Laboratories Atlanta facility, using infrastructure intended to approximate field conditions.

passages.locator: Printed pp. 1720–1721 / PDF pp. 4–5, system configuration and Chicago follow-on
passages.note: The source diagrams the DS3 optical system, describes the M13 multiplex and D3 channel bank and distinguishes Atlanta’s evaluation from trial customer traffic at Chicago from 11 May 1977.
